member.summary: Reconciles seasons and episodes with the series' finalized state.
member.remarks: The series' presentation unique key can change during a refresh once provider ids become available - notably with EnableAutomaticSeriesGrouping, where the key is derived from the provider id and the owning libraries instead of the (immutable) item id. Seasons and episodes cache this value in and are matched to (and displayed under) the series by it, so any child left with a stale key - or an episode not yet linked to a freshly created season - stays hidden until a later scan.
